_comment: Sample Microsoft Sentinel automation rule that runs the Triage Reasoner playbook on incident creation. Deploy with: az rest --method put --url "https://management.azure.com/subscriptions/<SUB_ID>/resourceGroups/<RG>/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/<WORKSPACE_NAME>/providers/Microsoft.SecurityInsights/automationRules/<NEW_GUID>?api-version=2023-11-01" --body @automation-rule.sample.json. Prerequisite: the Azure Security Insights service principal must hold 'Microsoft Sentinel Automation Contributor' on the resource group that contains the playbook.

properties.displayName: Auto-Triage - Run Security Copilot Triage Reasoner
